notes.title: Beta v0.15.0: Reinforcement Update
notes.content:
After the long delay we were able to prepare a big update and prepare for the next update of the similar size!
We are adding 3 new enemies, 3 new achievements (with rewards), 5 new cards and 1 new starting ability.
[h2]New Enemies[/h2]
We are adding 3 new robots, and one familiar robot has been slightly reworked. New plant enemies are already scripted, that means they soon will be added to the bunker.

1.	Vacuumer – robot-vacuum cleaner, it will not allow you to pollute the battle board with those pesky tokens!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/26ad8c669013f805c88362e17ed356e1b6bf3e91.png[/img]
2.	Robocopter – flying engineer that will try to attack you from different angles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/9cf9414201ec7121708f7acd74db77d15b3a87c1.png[/img]
3.	Diegger – new elite shaft miner with big shield
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/028f2cbc83b1840b78b9a493158212b2ca793140.png[/img]
4. Scout (elite robot) is now slightly less predictable and a bit more aggressive.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
-	[b]Russian Roulette[/b] – Buy an Ammo card
Unlocks 2 new cards that have Ammo synergy
-	[b]Target Dummy[/b] – Win 4 normal battles
Unlocks 1 new (Epic) card that shuffles a another card which shuffles even more powerful card
-	[b]Toxic Behavior[/b] – Deal 30 damage with a single Acid token
Unlocks new starting ability – River Toad Toxin, which replaces basic [b]Attack[/b] cards with cards that place [b]Acid[/b] (2) (Flexibles and Best Offense are not replaced)
-	[b]Berserk[/b] reworked – Play Break effect 10 times

[h2]New Cards[/h2]
- [b]Tincture[/b] – Place [b]Acid[/b] 4 / [b]Break[/b] 1 / If on BOTTOM / Place [b]Acid[/b] 6 / [b]Break[/b] 1
- [b]Bloody Ammo[/b] - [b]Piercing Attack[/b] 3 / [b]Armor[/b] 1 / [b]Break[/b] 1
- [b]Setup[/b] – Draw 1 / Place [b]Repair[/b] 2 / [b]Armor[/b] 3 / Shuffle [b]Execution[/b] to your deck / [b]Remove[/b] (What does [b]Execution[/b] does? Hm…)
- [b]Extra Magazine[/b] – Armor 2/ Shuffle "Replicant Ammo" to your deck (4 connections, Attack 3, Remove)
- [b]Sacrifice[/b] - [b]Piercing Attack[/b] 20 / [b]Sacrifice[/b] 8
(rework) - [b]Pain Inhibitor[/b] – Set your health 1 / Attack 3*Х, where Х is your missing health / [b]Remove[/b]

[h2]New Mechanics[/h2]
- Add a card to your deck – Shuffles a card only for this battle
- Piercing Attack – Attack that ignore enemy armor.
- Direct Hit counter – Attack on card becomes Piercing Attack
- Shield – Disables Attack on the card
[h2]QoL[/h2]
-	Samish effects are now stacked on the battle board ([b]Copy[/b] and [b]Remove[/b])
-	Achievement progress is now visible during gameplay 
-	Next available achievements are now visible in main menu
-	Some corrections in localization strings

That is all for today! We have not yet decided when to release next update, but since most of content is planned and/or programmed already, it can be sooner rather than later. Also, since we took extra time with this update, we actually had time to test it and have caught some bugs preemptively!
Hope to see you soon! [strike](And not with hotfix)[/strike]

notes.title: Beta v0.14.0: Tutorial Update
notes.content:
Hello again!
In today update we remade the tutorial which will be incorporated in soon-to-be released tutorial. Some small A small QoL improvements is also here.

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/833c984b8ae3d18bc4f1b3e706942f891174ee03.png[/img]

Our friend will help you understand the game in 15-20 minutes in a specially constructed bunker. If you are an experienced player but still want to play the tutorial for some reason, you can by changing show_tutorial option in config file (you will have to run the game at least once for the option to appear).

[h2]Demo Version[/h2]

Demo version will be released soon. It will only include tutorial and achievements will be disabled.

[h2]Library Search[/h2]

It is now possible to search cards in the library by text or titles.

This update is not big since we did some internal upgrading and, well, tutorial took much time. But starting with next update we will focus on bringing new content. See you soon!

notes.title: Beta v0.13.0: Architecture Update
notes.content:
After a brief vacation we add new rooms to the bunker! It is now a little bit complex but also more rewarding to explore…

[h2]New rooms[/h2]

[b]Locked Storage Room[/b] – to open this room you have to spend [b]Energy[/b]. It also contains some basic resources in it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/0707d2be354579a0cb5d4b491adac4e6663da737.png[/img]

[b]Crossroads[/b] – changes corridors around after each step
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/0ae8c5bf317b6b5f00f88997e0607ffc59c0b705.png[/img]

[b]Auto Reroll[/b] – rerolls the shop when you enter
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/66b2175433e3a76c8e1a5a0800a0137bdba6b3ec.png[/img]

[b]Library[/b] – you exchange rerolls for a new ability here
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/22a4075a4fe1c3dda0083ff3e12807d01f7f34a5.png[/img]

[b]Recycle room[/b] – exchanges your [b]Health[/b] for [b]Energy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/5f276da4d3650112bca31903f4a471755bb93498.png[/img]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]
[b]Over Charge[/b] – Now [b]Removes[/b] itself and not the next card
[b]Critical Error[/b] – changed connections
[b]Recycle Techs[/b] – now [b]Draws[/b] 2 [b]Removed[/b] cards (was 1)
[b]Duplicate[/b] – [b]Attack[/b] 1, [b]Attack[/b] 1, [b]Armor[/b] 1 (extra [b]Attack[/b])
[b]Infinite Ammo[/b] – removed one connection (4 -> 3)
[b]Maneuver[/b] – [b]Attack[/b] increased by 1
[b]Regen Plates[/b] – removed one connection (4 -> 3)
[b]Sword and Shield[/b] – [b]Attack[/b] 1 (was 2), [b]Armor[/b] 3 (was 1), 2 connections (was 3)
[b]Stasis Gun[/b] – [b]Attack[/b] 4. [b]Armor[/b] 3. [b]Draw[/b] 1, [b]Remove[/b], (more attack, added [b]Draw[/b])
[b]Step Back[/b] – removed one connection (3 -> 2)
[b]Hidden Roots[/b] – reworked, you will have to find and buy 2 of these to gain a new ability

This is it for now. See you in two weeks! Would like to hear what you think, here and on our Discord!
We have some work to do…

notes.title: Beta v0.12.0: Utility Update
notes.content:
Welcome back to our regular biweekly update!
This time we can present you a new mechanic which we feel was the missing piece of this game's engine: utility cards. All counters also got some sort of animation to make it clearer what is happening, some bugs got fixed, some technical improvements are implemented. The usual.

[h2]Utility Cards[/h2]

We have new [i]type[/i] of cards which are only activated when you buy them and usually don't add to your deck. Almost all of them got art from the get-go.
Here are some of them:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/29467e0f9043913bdfaba070101543be59cd8e52.png[/img]

You will see them more the more you level up the shop! We think that some of them are very powerful so they would probably be tweaked in some way. Feel free to tell us how you feel about them!

[h2]Counter Animations[/h2]

All relevant counters got animations. Now, you will see an enemy glowing in blue when their defense has risen, the value of acid damage when it is covered with your card, etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/6110a9b73a92d143a5e85980add5f738fe9d85ab.gif[/img]

[h2]Better Windowed Mode[/h2]

It is still not perfect! We will fix it in the future. But it is a start. Now the game does not just stretch itself and render at 1080p, it actually tries to match the window resolution.

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Some enemy counters are now [b]Permanent[/b], which means you cannot place your tokens on top of them
[*] [b]Digger[/b] (1st floor Normal enemy) now only locks 1 connection on the board
[*] [b]Acid Ammo[/b] changed ([b]Acid 2, Copy, Remove[/b] -> [b]Attack 2, Acid 1[/b]), to make it similar to other Ammo cards
[*] [b]Acid Strike[/b] changed ([b]Acid 1, Attack 3[/b] -> [b]Acid 3[/b])
[*] Shop card generation slightly changed for new cards
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Rare bug when [b]Raftenzia[/b] (2nd floor Elite) could softlock itself when the [b]Fetters[/b] counter was not closed and new [b]Fetters[/b] spawned on top of it
[*] Fixed [b]Polycephaly[/b] enemy counter, now it actually lowers enemy attack
[*] Fixed [b]Critical Error[/b] text (X [b]Attack[/b] from removed cards -> 2*X [b]Attack[/b])
[*] [b]Atomic Battery[/b] now works correctly with [b]Upgrade[/b] cards
[*] Cards with [b]Hack[/b] are no longer broken
[*] [b]On Edge[/b] ability is no longer broken
[*] Card rewards on result screen are now visible
[/list]

[h2]Near Future plans[/h2]

We are sorry, but the next patch will be delayed by one week. We worked hard to bring you these updates on time and we really need a small rest. But don't worry, we have new art, new music and new content in the works, and we hope that some of it will be added in the next update!

See you in 3 weeks! ([strike]Or until we have a hotfix to release[/strike])

notes.title: Beta v0.11.0: Acid Update.
notes.content:
Two weeks pass and Wednesday comes, that means it is time for the next Beta update!
This update is focused on minor graphical improvements and new content. There are new card mechanics, all tokens are prettier now and we also remade "Reward Screen" that you see after finishing the run to make it clearer what rewards you actually got.
There was also some extensive code rewriting going on, so, please, if you encounter any bugs, let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/EZBNA3wpMx]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/exilland]Twitter[/url] or here.

[h2]Acid[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/0738bf0db6b8e03c47d9f302bf7e56d684274981.gif[/img] 
This is a new [b]Acid[/b] token, it can be placed on the battlefield by cards or abilities. It will deal pure damage to the enemy each turn and become stronger as long as you close it with your cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/1932a7c8a265da3d1d2f249c80108e2324b774ce.png[/img]

[h2]Ammo[/h2]
All cards with the word “Ammo” in the title belong to the new card type “Ammo”. Currently there is only one ability that interacts with it, but we probably will make more synergies in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/322a28e767b4b5cd2764d7f534c1890f94570980.png[/img]

[h2]Abilities[/h2]
There are 4 new abilities for you to explore.
[b]Blueprints[/b] – All [b]Ammo[/b] cards gain +3 attack 
[b]Workout[/b] – Gain 1 [b]Attack[/b] at the start of each turn, upgrade this after beating an elite or boss enemy 
[b]Plague[/b] - At the start of your turn place an [b]Acid[/b] token on board
[b]Refactoring[/b] - Hand size increased by 2, you can't [b]Draw[/b] additional cards

[h2]Rewards screen[/h2]
The screen that you see when you beat the dungeon or die trying. You can now see progress of your achievements and rewards you got.
As usual, thank you for your attention! We would very much like to get any of your feedback!
See you soon!

notes.title: Beta v0.10.0: Polishing update
notes.content:
Welcome back, explorer! 
In this update we tried to bring more "life" in our game. We added extra animations which should make it clearer what is happening in battles and added art on some of the cards (currently for testing purposes). We really would like to hear your opinion about have it is implemented, but please give it a try first (if you really hate them, you can disable them).

[h2]Executing Effects[/h2]
Card effects are now executed one-by-one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/b9664b22de3b53f56199a9ca8c9a53893848d0d7.gif[/img]

[h2]Shop[/h2]
Player can now level up the shop, increasing the probability of cards of higher rarity. Also if you level up to level 5, your hand size will be increased.
You can level up Shop by spending [b]rerolls[/b]. You can level up 4 times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/23e24ab9ad229339b647ee8ee9fdc7f07f871eb9.png[/img]

[h2]Art on cards[/h2]
In version 0.10 all basic cards have an art. The art dynamically changes transparency depending on where the card is and the cursor position.
Currently, it is possible to disable card arts in settings via "Disable visual effects".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/35b13645a04cf6a3769c6dfdac1d174a4ecb816e.png[/img]

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

[h3]Enemies[/h3]

Mushroom King: Attack 10 - Attack 8
Raffenzia: Attack 20 - Attack 16 / Armor 2 - Armor 0

[h3]Cards[/h3]

[b]Backstab[/b]: Attack 3 - Attack 4
[b]Side Module[/b]: Upgrade by 3 - Upgrade by 4
[b]Firewall Exeption[/b]: + Armor 2
[b]Indinite Ammo[/b]: Attack 6 - Attack 10, one connection.
[b]Removable Plates[/b]: Armor 4 - Armor 8, one connection.
[b]Thrust[/b]: Attack 3 - Attack 4
[b]Unstable Field[/b] - Now placing [b]Heal 1[/b]
[b]Unstable Impulse[/b] - Now placing [b]Weak Spot 3[/b]
[b]Emergence Module[/b]: If HP<5 - [b]Break 1[/b]

notes.title: Beta v0.9.0: Visual Update
notes.content:
Welcome to our decorated bunker!

In this patch we mostly made upgrades to the visuals. Tweaked user interface, remade main menu, cards highlighting and animations, and last but not least, all enemies on the first floor are now able to attack! Also, it is now possible to sort cards in the deck and some technologies got balance updates.

[h2]Visual improvements[/h2]

We listened to feedback coming from you and upgraded some visuals. We do not plan to stop on this, however, so please continue to talk to us!

[h3]Main menu[/h3]

Our talented friend @zerow_z made a beautiful background for the main menu, take a look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/523006cc72d167add9d062d1088a60b1488073b9.gif[/img]

Following this, we almost remade Main Menu, so it is much more pleasant to look at.

[h3]Color-coding[/h3]

All cards are now color-coded, so it is much easier to distinguish them on first glance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/ecf9b5109015ce1e3a09fecc37ca24556348b169.png[/img]

[h3]Card Animations[/h3]

New animations for rerolling, buying a card and trading cards on stations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/5c726ef31950a36fd1e968f9d3711aa565cf2b7a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/e944e5b225b98191622d65e42bda55b01416c772.gif[/img]

[h3]Enemy Animations[/h3]

Unfortunately, it is not feasible for us to make a full attack animation for each enemy, but we made alternative "attack" sprites so it is more clear when enemy attacks you. Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/13735c8e2c2451636b442a6c177ab40c21bb3b09.png[/img]

[h2]Balance Updates[/h2]

In this patch we only changed technologies (old values are in brackets).

[h3]List of balance changes:[/h3]

- [b]Adrenalin[/b] - If [b]HP[/b] ≤ 10 (5): draw an extra card at the start of your turn

- [b]Better Reflexes[/b] - Each [b]Draw[/b] is also an [b]Attack[/b] 2 (1)

- [b]Repair Cert.[/b] - On [b]Break[/b] gain [b]Armor[/b] 2 (1)

- [b]Overheat[/b] - Each turn enemy takes 5 (3) damage and you take 1 non-lethal damage

- [b]Recycle[/b] - For each (2) [b]Removed[/b] cards, gain [b]Attack[/b] 1

- [b]Replicant[/b] - Each turn gain additional card: 4 connections, [b]Attack[/b] 3 (1), 
[b]Remove[/b]

- [b]Stasis Field[/b] - At the start of battle, gain [b]Armor[/b] 5 (4)

[h3]List of reworks:[/h3]

- [b]Hard Steel[/b] - (Cards that [b]Remove[/b] themselves are discarded instead.) -> You receive a copy of every [b]Removed[/b] card in discard.

- [b]On Edge[/b] - (Max HP is set to 5. You cannot be killed by your cards.) -> Max HP is set to 5. Every [b]Break[/b] becomes [b]Repair[/b] 

Thank you so much for your attention!
We would like to hear all and any of your opinions in Steam Discussions, [url=https://twitter.com/exilland]Twitter[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/EZBNA3wpMx]Discord[/url] :)

notes.title: Beta v0.8.0: Major Balance update.
notes.content:
It is nice to see you in the bunker again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/8e38101188f20b4c0b031d46af08fc2434320d32.gif[/img]

First of all, thank you so much for your support! It really inspires and gives strength. Also, thanks for the bug reports, not only were they useful, but some bugs were reported already with fixes :)

[h2]General changes[/h2]

We have made many changes since the last update. Most of the card had their power tweaked, some of the cards changed so much you would not recognize them. Enemies also become more powerful to compensate for cards power increase.
You can find full list of card changes on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/cGQF2jyWTu

We also have some new mechanics which would help you better control the flow of battle:
[b]Place a token[/b] – you would place a token under the card which will be available next turn. These tokens may help player as well as make next turn harder. You can see which token would be placed in the card text. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/4d1c193ac0572d4104e47c1dc822c50aa8caadea.png[/img]

[b]Copy[/b] – you will get a copy of the card in your hand

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/dbe2777b00e3733349dd00a23d8018b1da1aeb82.png[/img]

[b]Hack[/b] – this effect is the same as a token effect of a Hacker enemy. Hacked cards swap their attack and armor, self-damage and heal, etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/81e9bbdd50bcafd2976f76646166e2abfa343ea7.gif[/img]

[h3]Boss Battle Rewards[/h3]
In most cases players chose to defeat as many enemies on the map as possible before challenging the boss. Game mechanics almost forced your hand to grind. But now, you will get increased rewards from boss battle if you take less turns to explore the level. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/0e668585e4ff322eb376f762cb32eae2610f4d36.png[/img]

Now there is some sense in planning your way around to probably get more rewards from boss. But you still can kill as much enemies as possible to be better prepared for the boss battle.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Once again, thank you so much for bug reports, and please, do not hesitate to post bug reports on forums, Discord or just send them to dev@exilland.dev in the future :)
-	Fixed localization crash. If your system language is not supported the game will fallback to English.
-	It is no longer possible to infinitely upgrade [b]Effective Strat[/b] card.
-	Achievements should sync with Steam now.
-	There should be way less random crashes if you experienced them before.
-	Technology [b]On Edge[/b] now updates player health the moment it is picked up.

[h2]Quality of Life improvements[/h2]
-	Enemy effect [b]Muddle[/b] now has a tooltip window.
-	It is possible now to scroll your hand if you draw too many cards.
-	Extra option in options to disable graphical effects that can be disturbing.

[h2]Future[/h2]
Our plan in the future is to release new patch every 2 weeks on Wednesday with the hotfix in the middle. These patches will have some general direction and usually contain some sort of new content.
Next patch will be mostly about graphical improvements, please stay tuned :)
Thank you so much for following us!

notes.title: Beta v0.7.5: Early Access Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/afedcd62637095eb7f5e87f067cd852870a58079.png[/img]

Hello there, folks!
After a long hiatus, we are glad to introduce you an early access build of our game!
We've got a lot of interesting stuff (only) in it. The main feature is an upgraded achievement based progression system.
Now, you can get different ingame rewards for completing achievements so that each your run is diverse and more fun!

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
At the moment there are 10 achievements in the game. Completing all of them would give you 3 packs of 10 cards, 4 starting power-ups (technologies) and a battery that can keep your energy between the runs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/8c32166d286a73fdc45989a1bfb6ff445551fd5c.png[/img]

[h3]Bioms[/h3]
For now, there are two floors in the bunker and each of them is inhabited with unique enemies.
Ground floor is filled with offices and living rooms through which robots continue to roam. 
Second floor is a plant growing laboratory that was dilapidated during the 'Incident'. It is inhabited by agile and flexible plants and there is a lot of fresh air to breathe.


[h3]Upgrades[/h3]
For defeating strong enemies you will receive technology upgrades which can be one-time effects or continuous buffs. 
Those techs will highlight the strengths of your deck and provide vast possibilities getting new and fun combinations! 



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38948934/aaa29104c5bd78e9090e43b3ea2d88f807d73cbe.png[/img]

[h3]Cards[/h3]
We've also added a lot of new cards that you can get by completing achievements.
Also, many existing cards have undergone changes for balancing purposes.

For those who are not familiar with the new keywords:

 * [b]Break X[/b] - Take X unblockable damage. (it can be upgraded, so be careful!)
 * [b]Remove[/b] - After use, the card will be removed from the deck until the end of the battle.
